name: Verify the user already completed the x amount of sales and there is an active promotion which requires x amount of sales. When that user is added to the dynamic audience group now (i.e, after the sales are present inside the system), then the user will get the reward as he/she acheived it.
fullName: src/features/promotions/sellXgetY.feature#Verify the user already completed the x amount of sales and there is an active promotion which requires x amount of sales. When that user is added to the dynamic audience group now (i.e, after the sales are present inside the system), then the user will get the reward as he/she acheived it.
